parts.text: (a) There are 49 students in a year group. content.tex: There are 49 students in a year group.
Each student studies at least one of the sciences, biology \((B),\) chemistry \((C)\) and physics \((P).\)
\(x\) students study all 3 sciences. \(y\) students study chemistry only. 12 students study physics only.
6 students study biology and chemistry but not physics. 11 students study biology and physics but not chemistry. 2 students study physics and chemistry but not biology.
